name: Propeller platform (incl. AeroPoints GCPs)

name: Trimble Stratus (powered by Propeller)

data_residency_gdpr: Not stated in sources reviewed (Procore EU zone may apply post-merger — unverified)
status: Active; acquired by Procore (agreement 27 Jul 2026, closed 9 Sep 2026, ~USD 845m)
notes: Strongest drone-to-PM consolidation signal of 2026; O8 Partial = schedule deviation reports, not commercial alerts.

name: PIX4Dmatic + PIX4Dcloud
